note: Poland: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). Everyone else needs a work permit for a foreigner (with the residence that goes with it); foreigners performing artistic services, alone or in groups, for up to 30 days in a calendar year are exempt (taken as 30 days within 365). Read from the Labour Ministry's Zielona Linia portal; whether the act on entrusting work to foreigners keeps the exemption in exactly these words isn't checked against the Dziennik Ustaw.
